senses.gloss:
__1 N. of a sage belonging to the family of Aṅgiras, father of Śatānanda and husband of Ahalyā. 
__2 N. of a sage, the founder of Nyāya philosophy; मुक्तये यः शिलात्वाय शास्त्रमूचे सचेतसाम् । गोतमं तमवेक्ष्यैव [[N. 17. 75.]]

Ahalyā, wife of गोतम. 
-Comp. 
-पुत्रः an epithet of Śatānanda.
